back.en: It isn’t spelled as it sounds

extra.ru:
В английском учите произношение вместе со словом. Помогает транскрипция [ ] в словаре.
> I read a book. [audio](media:e1986e5be4e04bf1bfccf31d)
> — Я читаю книгу.
extra.en:
In English learn pronunciation together with the word. The [ ] transcription in a dictionary helps.
> I read a book. [audio](media:e1986e5be4e04bf1bfccf31d)
> — I read a book.

extra.ru:
A перед согласным звуком (a cat), an — перед гласным (an apple). Артиклей нет в русском, поэтому их нужно запомнить.
> I have a cat. The cat is black. [audio](media:bceccb39e5356c8c329659b2)
> — У меня есть кот. Кот чёрный.
extra.en:
A before a consonant sound (a cat), an before a vowel sound (an apple). Russian has no articles, so you must learn them.
> I have a cat. The cat is black. [audio](media:bceccb39e5356c8c329659b2)
> — I have a cat. The cat is black.

back.ru: am, is, are — в настоящем времени глагол нужен всегда
back.en: am, is, are — the verb is always required

extra.ru:
I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are. По-русски «Я студент» — по-английски «I am a student».
> I am a student. [audio](media:c2a78be40a016ef34c8a3074)
> — Я студент.
extra.en:
I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are. In Russian “Я студент” has no verb — English needs one.
> I am a student. [audio](media:c2a78be40a016ef34c8a3074)
> — I am a student.

extra.ru:
Порядок жёсткий, в отличие от русского: Mom loves Dad ≠ Dad loves Mom.
> She reads books. [audio](media:f332e9d1c4f1e9cefb61d7e5)
> — Она читает книги.
extra.en:
Order is fixed, unlike Russian: Mom loves Dad ≠ Dad loves Mom.
> She reads books. [audio](media:f332e9d1c4f1e9cefb61d7e5)
> — She reads books.

extra.ru:
cat → cats, box → boxes. Исключения: man → men, child → children, foot → feet.
> Two cats and three boxes. [audio](media:36f88d704336675efb30dc08)
> — Две кошки и три коробки.
extra.en:
cat → cats, box → boxes. Exceptions: man → men, child → children, foot → feet.
> Two cats and three boxes. [audio](media:36f88d704336675efb30dc08)
> — Two cats and three boxes.

extra.ru:
I work, you work, he works. Для регулярных действий: I drink tea every day.
> He works every day. [audio](media:15f36366cf8b6a53e64e7df6)
> — Он работает каждый день.
extra.en:
I work, you work, he works. For habits: I drink tea every day.
> He works every day. [audio](media:15f36366cf8b6a53e64e7df6)
> — He works every day.

extra.ru:
I don’t know. Do you speak English? He doesn’t like tea. После doesn’t глагол без -s!
> Do you speak English? [audio](media:cc0db5a642ab4c9e5b9a50a2)
> — Вы говорите по-английски?
extra.en:
I don’t know. Do you speak English? He doesn’t like tea. After doesn’t the verb has no -s!
> Do you speak English? [audio](media:cc0db5a642ab4c9e5b9a50a2)
> — Do you speak English?

extra.ru:
There is a book on the table. There are two books. Русское «у меня есть» — I have.
> There is a cup on the table. [audio](media:70873e19162a02560c57912e)
> — На столе чашка.
extra.en:
There is a book on the table. There are two books. Russian “у меня есть” — I have.
> There is a cup on the table. [audio](media:70873e19162a02560c57912e)
> — There is a cup on the table.

back.ru: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
back.en: I, you, he, she, it, we, they

extra.ru:
I всегда с заглавной. You — и «ты», и «вы». It — для вещей и животных.
> We are friends. [audio](media:77b3561dab8b34518281bf52)
> — Мы друзья.
extra.en:
I is always capitalised. You means both “ты” and “вы”. It is for things and animals.
> We are friends. [audio](media:77b3561dab8b34518281bf52)
> — We are friends.
